brand_identity.concept: Premium, culturally-rooted Indian AI voice-agent SaaS. Inspired by Sarvam.ai. Elegant, warm, spiritual minimalism combined with modern tech credibility.
brand_identity.primary_motif: Concentric lotus-mandala outlines, subtle arcs, petal shapes. Used as large, rotating background elements (opacity 5-10%) and subtle structural dividers.

guidelines: Use Cormorant Garamond for all H1, H2, H3 headings and large numerals. Tracking should be tight (tracking-tighter) for large sizes.
Use Manrope for body text, UI elements, buttons, and small labels. Keep it highly legible and clean.
Never center-align large blocks of text. Use left-alignment with generous padding.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' in italics for subtle, elegant emphasis or quotes.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use 2-3x normal padding (e.g., py-24, py-32 for sections) to give a luxurious, airy 'Sarvam.ai' feel.
layouts.grid: Bento grids with 1px subtle borders (border-[#E8DCC4]) and large internal padding (p-8 to p-12).
layouts.borders: Avoid heavy shadows. Use delicate 1px solid borders for definition, or very soft ambient shadows.

guidelines: Implement Lenis for smooth, premium momentum scrolling.
Kinetic Hero: Masked line-by-line reveal for the main H1 using framer-motion (e.g., initial { y: '100%' } animate { y: 0 } within an overflow-hidden wrapper).
3D/Parallax Moment: A large SVG lotus/mandala positioned absolutely in the hero background, rotating incredibly slowly (duration 60s+).
Use Case Cards: Hover interactions that expand or reveal a 'sample chat' interface smoothly.

visual_enhancers.mandala_motif: Use inline SVGs for mandala/lotus patterns. Style with stroke='#6E1A1A' and strokeWidth='1' or '0.5' at very low opacity (5-10%).
visual_enhancers.noise: Optional: A highly subtle, fixed background SVG noise texture (opacity 2-3%) over the entire page to give it a printed, 'paper' feel.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons are Deep Maroon with Cream text. Hover states lift slightly (-translate-y-0.5) with a soft shadow.

sections_guidance.name: Navbar
sections_guidance.details: Sticky, glassmorphism (bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-md). Display exact logo image on the left. Nav links in Manrope, secondary colors. Primary CTA in deep maroon.

sections_guidance.name: Hero
sections_guidance.details: Massive typography 'Your business, always on call' in Cormorant Garamond. Use kinetic masked line-by-line reveal. Background features a slowly rotating, large, subtle (5% opacity) maroon mandala/lotus SVG. Add an 'Animated voice demo' UI element (minimalist waveform or chat pulse in maroon/brass).

sections_guidance.name: Logo Marquee
sections_guidance.details: Editorial typography for brand names (Spice Garden, Glow Salon, etc.). Slow, smooth scroll (using react-fast-marquee). Text color muted charcoal/maroon.

sections_guidance.name: How It Works (Manifesto)
sections_guidance.details: Numbered chapters ('1. Describe', '2. Customize', '3. Go Live'). Use massive serif numerals (text-8xl) tightly cropped. Elegant editorial layout with thin dividing lines.

sections_guidance.name: Use Cases
sections_guidance.details: Grid of cards. Each card uses culturally relevant photography (from image_urls). On hover, display an expandable sample chat overlay showing context-aware AI conversation.

sections_guidance.name: Platform Features
sections_guidance.details: Bento grid focusing on 'context-aware', 'no hallucination', 'always-on', etc. Warm beige card backgrounds with maroon typography and subtle lotus SVG watermark accents.

sections_guidance.name: Interactive ROI Calculator
sections_guidance.details: Functional sliders (calls/day, missed %, avg value) to calculate 'recovered revenue in ₹'. Use Radix/Shadcn sliders customized with maroon tracks and thumbs. Elegant numeral displays.

sections_guidance.name: Pricing
sections_guidance.details: Three tiers: Free, Pro, Business. Highlight 'Pro' with a solid maroon background and cream text. Include a Monthly/Annual toggle.

sections_guidance.name: Social Proof
sections_guidance.details: Testimonial cards with real Indian business owner portraits. Large serif quotation marks. High contrast text.

sections_guidance.name: Footer (Inverted)
sections_guidance.details: Dark section! bg-[#6E1A1A] with text-[#FDFBF7]. Massive 'VAANI' serif wordmark. Large lotus watermark. Final CTA.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standard. The charcoal maroon text (#2D1A1A) on cream background (#FDFBF7) provides excellent contrast.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='roi-slider', data-testid='pricing-toggle').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST strictly avoid generic 'SaaS Blue' or dark mode tropes. The site is a warm, well-lit, luxury editorial space.
Do NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Customise Shadcn components to match the brand identity (e.g., override rounded corners, border colors).
Do not apply global transitions like 'transition: all'. Apply specific transitions (opacity, transform) to avoid breaking framer-motion.
Use Phosphor Icons (thin or light weight) or Lucide (strokeWidth=1.5) for a refined look.
Do not center align text heavily. Favor left-alignment with structured, clean grids.
Build the mandala motif using an inline SVG with precise path/circle geometries, applying a slow rotation animation using Framer Motion.

component_instructions.ui_components: Use Shadcn primitives but deeply customize them via Tailwind classes to remove the 'Vercel' look. Sliders and toggles must use the maroon/gold palette.
